verdict.rationale: Gitleaks is itself an official CLI. Its first-party README documents subcommands (`git`, `dir`, `stdin`) with concrete invocation examples, piping via stdin, baseline-based JSON report output, and installation via Homebrew, Docker or Go. A probe also confirms the official CLI documentation. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of CLI use in agentic workflows, and explicit documentation of machine-readable output options aimed at automated consumers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Gitleaks can be installed using Homebrew, Docker, or Go.
After running the detect command with the --baseline-path parameter, report output (findings.json) will only contain new issues.
